item.title: Weekend Forecast
item.description: Best surf: Cowell, Sunday, October 4 at 11 AM — 9 alone / 10 with instructor, the earliest of three tied top readings (Sunday 11 AM and 1 PM, Monday 9 AM). Capitola is closed to surfing by a county bacterial beach alert. Best jump: Sunday, October 4 at 9 AM at Skydive California — calm wind, gusts 5 mph, the smoothest slot in a window that is ✅ at every sample. All times PDT.
